case_number: 2025 INSC 109; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Civil) No.1399 of 2025)
summary: Christian burial rights in native village; opposition from villagers and Gram Panchayat; separate Christian graveyard absent in Chhindwada; history of Christian family burials at village graveyard; State certificate denying Christian burial ground; High Court denied relief, directed burial in distant Karkapal; appellant claims ancestral burial site and private land rights; tensions arising from religious conversion and community customs; statutory duties under Chhattisgarh Panchayat Raj Adhiniyam, 1993 and 1999 Rules on corpse disposal; plea for police protection and burial rights upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Chhattisgarh Panchayat Raj Adhiniyam, 1993 s.95, s.49(12)
Chhattisgarh Gram Panchayat (Regulating Places for Disposal of Dead Bodies, Carcasses and other Offensive Matter) Rules, 1999 r.3, r.4
